title: VideoVista-CulturalLingo: 360° Horizons-Bridging Cultures, Languages, and Domains in Video Comprehension

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the accuracy of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) on video question-answering tasks rooted in different regional cultural contexts (Chinese, American, and European) to identify Western-centric performance biases.
Comparing the performance gaps of multimodal models on video question-answering subtasks when the questions and options are presented in Chinese versus English.
